root_cause_analysis.primary_issue: Phase 1-4 implementation created validators and utilities, but Phase 5-6 integration was never completed
detailed_findings: ValidationPipeline and all validators (SourcePathRuleEngine, AgentConstraintValidator, WorkflowSchemaValidator) exist and pass tests, but are NEVER called in production workflow
The adapter.py does NOT import or use ValidationPipeline as documented in integration_points
The workflow_gen module has its OWN set of validators (agent_validator.py, reference_validator.py, structure_validator.py, syntax_validator.py) that are actually used in production
APISchemaInjector and WorkflowPatternLibrary exist but are not integrated into workflow_gen/prompt_builder/
ValidationObserver exists but is not used by ValidationPipeline (no integration found)
All features have unit tests that pass, creating the illusion of completeness, but integration tests only test the isolated ValidationPipeline, not its integration into the actual workflow

architecture_mismatch.explanation: Issue #342 created a new validation architecture (ValidationPipeline + validators), but the existing workflow_gen already had its own validators. The new validators were never integrated to replace or complement the old ones.
evidence: No integration found between the two
